description: For each trader type, count the distinct transactions that have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader. Report that count and its share of the total count over all trader types.

c.request: For each trader type, how many analysed trade records are there in the advanced behaviour data (only where the trade and its trader can be found), and what share of the overall total does each type make up? Keep the share unrounded. For each trader type, count the distinct transactions that have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader. Report that count and its share of the total count over all trader types.
c.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, cnt AS transaction_count, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM per_type ORDER BY tradekind

a.request: Considering only advanced behaviour analyses whose linked transaction record and trader both exist, for each trader type (`tradekind`) give the trader type, the number of distinct transactions analysed (a transaction analysed twice counts once), and that number divided by the total of these numbers over all trader types, without rounding.
a.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT a.translink) AS n FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, n AS distinct_transactions, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS proportion FROM x

b.request: For each trader type, count the distinct transaction records (transactionrecord.transreg) that have at least one advancedbehavior analysis and a matching trader, and report that count alongside its unrounded share of the total count across all trader types
b.sql: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg)) OVER () AS share FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM advancedbehavior ab WHERE ab.translink = tr.transreg) GROUP BY t.tradekind

d.request: For each trader type, how many distinct transactions have at least one advanced behaviour analysis record and a matching trader (excluding any whose trade or trader cannot be found), and what share of the total count across all trader types does each type's count represent, with the share left unrounded?
d.sql: SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg)) OVER () AS share FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind
